body_markdown:
OLATHE, Kan./Nov. 11, 2026 – Garmin (NYSE: GRMN) is showing its appreciation for members of the military with the launch of new **[U.S. Armed Forces watch faces](https://apps.garmin.com/apps/collection?ids=eb219952-db4f-44de-b9a3-5373055947e9,f4506dd2-72f6-43f5-a99f-46bc2ded5546,29e14918-662b-44f1-b7fd-dbb7d39514f1,bcc6cbe4-bf73-40a1-9e76-6cf59b1c7881,374f6bb3-6147-4eb1-874d-b373aeb8fb88)** , which feature the official logos for the U.S. Army, Marine Corps, Navy, Air Force and Space Force. Garmin brings the spirit of service to the wrist with these watch faces now available in the Connect IQ™ Store for select smartwatches, including fēnix®, Instinct®, tactix®, Forerunner® and more.


Inspired by the identity and traditions of the U.S. Armed Forces, the new watch faces allow Garmin customers to personalize their compatible smartwatch with designs representing the spirit of service, dedication and sacrifice. The collection reflects Garmin’s long-standing connection with people who challenge themselves, operate in demanding environments and rely on technology when performance matters most.


These watch faces give veterans, active-duty service members, military families and advocates a way to show their national pride and support. A portion of the proceeds supports the Morale, Welfare and Recreation fund – a network of quality-of-life, fitness, and leisure programs for military service members, their families and retirees.


Garmin customers can download the U.S. Armed Forces watch faces now in the Connect IQ Store.


The[Connect IQ Store](https://apps.garmin.com/) is an all-in-one source for Garmin customers looking to personalize their compatible Garmin devices. With thousands of options to choose from, users can download apps, watch faces, music streaming services and more, right to their device. The Connect IQ Store is accessible through the Google Play and Apple App Store. For more information,[email our media team](https://www.garmin.com/cdn-cgi/l/email-protection#264b43424f470854434a47524f494855664147544b4f480845494b) or connect with us on[LinkedIn](http://www.linkedin.com/company/garmin) . For developers interested in creating on-device applications for Garmin customers around the world, visit the[Connect IQ developer site](https://developer.garmin.com/connect-iq/) .
